name: Cabbage-wrapped oleaster
summary: Young green oleaster wrapped in cabbage and dipped in chẩm chéo. Vietnam News puts the fruit in the leaf. Vietnamnet adds ginger, coriander, and garlic leaf, and says there is no meat. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnam News and Vietnamnet both treat it as a Thái plate. Neither names a street.
taste: Vietnam News, quoting Hào Giàng Xén: the cabbage is acrid, the oleaster slightly sour, and the sauce brings ginger, chilli, and salt. Vietnamnet says sour, hot, salty, sweet, and fragrant, with no meat.
howToEat: Vietnam News: choose young green oleaster, wrap it in fresh cabbage, and dip it in chẩm chéo.
Vietnamnet: pick the fruit young, wash off the white bloom, and wrap the fruit with ginger, coriander, and garlic leaf in cabbage. Dip it in chẩm chéo.
A price and a stall hour are Check on arrival.
where: The Thái table. No street was printed. Check on arrival.
